use: Real-world shots: user's own footage first, then these. Download the file itself, keep its page URL, record licence and credit in sources.json.

sources.name: Pexels
sources.license: Pexels License — free, commercial use OK, attribution not required
sources.credit: Optional; naming the creator and Pexels is welcome.
sources.how: The search API needs a free key in the Authorization header. Without a key, pick a clip on the website and download its video file.
sources.limits: No identifiable person shown negatively or as endorsing the user; never as a brand mark; no reselling the clip unchanged.

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.license: Pixabay Content License — free, commercial use and edits OK, attribution not required
sources.how: The search API needs a key. Without one, find the clip on the site and download it; never hotlink.
sources.limits: Visible brands or trademarks may not be used to sell goods or services; people shown may not be used misleadingly.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.license: Varies per file (public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA, others) — read each file page
sources.credit: Whatever the file's licence demands; credit the original author, not the uploader.
sources.how: Public MediaWiki API, no key. Send a descriptive User-Agent and make one request at a time.
sources.limits: Files are WebM/Ogg — transcode a working copy for the edit. Trademark and personality rights may still cover what is shown.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.license: Generally not copyrighted; must not imply NASA endorsement; NASA brand rules apply
sources.credit: NASA, or the credit line on the item page.
sources.how: Public search API, no key: search?q=TERM&media_type=video, then the item's asset endpoint lists its files.
sources.limits: The NASA logo and insignia are not free to use; items marked as third-party copyrighted need the holder's permission.
